correctness.rationale: The conditional uniform-remnant lemma is proved from independent arrow images; factorial and PGF identities follow exactly. Direct ordered-cycle counting establishes per-length means. Birthday survival and permutation cycle couplings give component-count stochastic monotonicity. Gaussian-window Riemann-sum domination establishes n(a_n-a_{n-1})→1/2 and covariance→−1/(2e). Exact exhaustive finite checks through n=6 and supplementary arithmetic checks corroborate but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: A canonical pair of random functional-graph statistics gains a complete exact joint transform and stronger factorial regression. The terminal-node/cycle-class sign pattern includes an exact zero for fixed points and strict negativity for all other cycle lengths.
